claim_origin: Guest / interviewee — political activist Smadar Hila Shmueli
claim_text: On an Erel Segal program, Shmueli highlighted claims that Shikma Bressler was deleting posts and earlier protest warnings, insinuating that protest leaders had advance knowledge of the October 7 attack.
discovery_sources: Exact Channel 14 broadcast preserved by Bodkim X; The Seventh Eye; Second Authority public-complaints response quoted by ICE
resolution_notes: Exact broadcast video was recovered through The Seventh Eye's petition coverage. The regulator response corrects the earlier candidate metadata: the broadcast was Erel Segal's program on 2023-11-15, not The Patriots on 2023-11-16. Narrow verdict is Unsupported because credible non-social counter-evidence found no substantiation for the advance-knowledge insinuation. Origin remains Guest / interviewee. Channel 14's explicit on-air/editorial rejection and later decision not to invite Shmueli for the time being are preserved; no motive is inferred. Full Sheet -> exact media -> stable GitHub preview -> Notion -> post-write verification pipeline completed.
